label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the candidate.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and pressure-day-type splits beside it.
The full-allotment period is short: its group is read as a count of days beside its mean, and no tail rate is read from fewer days than the interval can support.
The page ends with marked questions for Eleonora with numbered options and defaults that change no claim.
